mapper.select: SELECT m.month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.type = 'income' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.type = 'expense' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM ( SELECT '01' AS month UNION ALL SELECT '02' UNION ALL SELECT '03' UNION ALL SELECT '04' UNION ALL SELECT '05' UNION ALL SELECT '06' UNION ALL SELECT '07' UNION ALL SELECT '08' UNION ALL SELECT '09' UNION ALL SELECT '10' UNION ALL SELECT '11' UNION ALL SELECT '12' ) m LEFT JOIN bill b ON DATE_FORMAT(b.date, '%m') = m.month AND b.user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(b.date) = #{year} GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month
